name: Protecting the Shipment
summary: In southern Loch Modan, Miran carries blasting powder toward Ironband's Excavation Site. Prospector Ironband needs it to keep his dig moving, but the road is dangerous.

sections.title: A Powder Run in Peril
sections.body: Prospector Ironband's dig in the hills of southern Loch Modan needs blasting powder to cut through stone. Supply lines have failed, and threats to the courier wagons leave Miran stranded on the road with a heavy load. You guide him along the uneven roads to the excavation site, where the powder can keep Ironband's work from stalling.

sections.title: Dark Iron Sympathizers
sections.body: Dark Iron infiltrators wait near the excavation site to seize the explosive cargo. Their ambush reveals that Dark Iron forces are securing illicit materials and sowing discord in Loch Modan. The delivery keeps the dig going, but Ironband now knows enemy sabotage reaches into Alliance territory.

faq.answer: Miran is an Alliance courier carrying vital supplies, including blasting powder, along Loch Modan's dangerous back roads toward Ironband's Excavation Site.

faq.q: Why does Prospector Ironband need the powder?
faq.answer: Prospector Ironband leads an archaeological dig in southern Loch Modan. His team needs blasting powder to clear rock, uncover buried relics, and keep the work going.
Dark Iron dwarf saboteurs ambush Miran near the excavation site, seeking the explosives and trying to thwart Ironforge's operations in the region.
The escort follows a road in southern Loch Modan and ends at Ironband's Excavation Site in the hills southeast of the lake.

faq.q: Why are Dark Irons in Loch Modan?
faq.answer: The Dark Iron clan keeps secret enclaves and spies throughout Khaz Modan. They raid supply lines, sabotage Explorers' League digs, and seek to weaken Ironforge's defenses.

faq.q: What happens after the shipment arrives?
faq.answer: Prospector Ironband receives the powder and thanks the Light that it arrived, though Dark Iron sympathizers are operating nearby.

angles.text: As a dwarf of Ironforge, you defend Ironband's supplies and protect ancestral discoveries from sabotage by your bitter Dark Iron kin.
As an Alliance member, you help keep Loch Modan's couriers safe from subterranean raiders and preserve the link between Ironforge and the eastern frontiers.
As a miner, you know the value and danger of blasting powder when cutting into Khaz Modan's stubborn bedrock.
